text: Hmm, I don't think there are any variations. The name is Yusuf Hernandez, and the zip is 90210. I only use the email I gave you. I don't really have other order IDs memorized, I just know this one. This is getting a bit confusing.
zh: 嗯，我不认为有任何变化。姓名是Yusuf Hernandez，邮编是90210。我只使用您给我的电子邮件。我真的记不住其他订单号，我只知道这一个。这有点让人困惑。
